title: Major disappointment!
text: Major disappointment!. This arrived with one corner of the plastic box broken and the flip-up spout missing entirely!  Could possibly make it work for storing flour, but it's absolutely worthless for air-tight storage.  Will never order from this company (Prepworks) again!

product_metadata.title: Progressive International PKS-500 ProKeeper Plastic Sugar Storage Container with Stainless Steel Hinges, Clear
features: KEEPS SUGAR FRESH: Countertop sugar container that helps keep your sugar fresher for longer
LARGE CAPACITY: Can hold up to 2.3 quarts or a 4-pound bag of sugar with ease
AIRTIGHT STORAGE: Silicone seal strip ensures airtight storage
UNIQUE DESIGN: Designed with stainless steel hinges that swing wide open for easy access
GREAT FOR ONE-HAND USE: Flip-to-pour spout and contoured body allow for easy, one-hand use
description: The Prep works by progressive sugar ProKeeper storage container combines high quality construction with a silicone seal for air-tight storage. The flip-to-pour spout and contoured body make for easy one-handed use. The 2. 3-Quart storage container has measurement markings clearly display remaining sugar and includes an easy-catch latch that holds the lid tightly closed. The patent pending stainless steel hinges swing wide open for no-fuss access to fill or measure and will fit into the dishwasher for easy care. The sugar ProKeeper will easily hold a 4-lb. Bag of brown Sugar with room to spare And measures 6. 75"" L x 4. 75"" W x 7. 5""H.
